item.title: Two-Vehicle Accident on Main Street in Centre
item.description: CENTRE, Ala.– A two-vehicle accident occurred on Main Street around 2 p.m. Tuesday, just west of the Chevron, involving a white Ford F-150 and a burgundy Toyota Corolla LE. The driver of the Toyota was injured. Centre Police and Centre Fire Department responded to the scene. Atrium Floyd-EMS was also dispatched to assist.
